declared_scale: Entry point plus a package of at least 3 modules with an internal API, one builder task, 6 automated checks with 10 build cases (5 held out), plus 15 extended held-out cases and a structure check scored after the build

expected_requests.note: At least one repair round is plausible at this scale; it is measured, not required

expected_cost_usd: 0.00 on a plan-backed route (plan_roles). Any metered route is out of this packet
pass_bar_per_attempt: Studio build reaches verified: QA passes 10 of 10 frozen build cases, including 5 of 5 held out, in the WSL2 isolation worker
Independent reviewer verdict is approve on the final candidate
Requests used are at most the plan's max_calls (6)
Exported package scored by scripts/p14-benchmark.mjs passes 10 of 10 build cases and 15 of 15 extended cases
Structure check passes: src/ledger has parse.py, rules.py and report.py, each defines a function, and main.py imports from ledger
qualified_at_declared_scale_when: All 3 attempts meet every pass bar. Fewer is recorded as k of 3 and is not qualified; nothing is re-run to replace a failure
invalid_attempt_when: An infrastructure fault outside the roles (worker crash, studio restart, plan outage) stops the attempt before a verdict. It is recorded with its cause and replaced at most once
measure_and_record: requests used and repair rounds used
wall time from Start to verified or failed
files changed and lines in the final diff (multi-file change count)
QA pass counts development and held out
export scorer result, extended suite pass count and structure check
plan daily request count before and after
known_failure_cases: import ledger without adding src to sys.path (python3 -I): every case fails
Fields trimmed of spaces, or + accepted in amounts
Errors and report printed together, or the first error only
Capped categories with no rows omitted
JSON key order or separators different from json.dumps(sort_keys=True)
limits_found_while_freezing: A studio build runs at most 10 cases per task (MAX_BUILD_CASES), so the matrix's 15+ cases cannot all run in the studio's QA; the extended suite covers the rest outside it
The studio builds only builder tasks with no dependencies, so a multi-task DAG with checkpoints cannot be benchmarked yet (P15 slice 3)
